Facts:

The Cedar crate weighs 27,367 kg.
The Juniper crate weighs 64,321 kg.
The Hazel crate weighs 49,160 kg.
The Ivy crate weighs 27,713 kg.
The Alder crate weighs 47,393 kg.

List the 5 labels from the lightest crate to the heaviest.

Give the labels only, in the requested order, separated by commas.
Reason as much as you like, then finish with one final line of the form
ANSWER: <your answer>

content.text:
Sorting the weights: Cedar 27,367 < Ivy 27,713 < Alder 47,393 < Hazel 49,160 < Juniper 64,321.

ANSWER: Cedar, Ivy, Alder, Hazel, Juniper
